It was 0129 first, then 0130 after main's 0129_document_edit_notices; it was renumbered in the forward merge 071af05a. store's TestMigrationSetIsNumberedOneToN refuses a gap or a repeat, so main's highest migration is checked again before every push.

Same-document pointer targets are resolved from the rendered block offsets of the tree the write leaves (exactly what document_blocks will hold), other documents from document_blocks by node_id, any row of a disallowed type refusing (node_id is not unique).

The graph_edges block arm and the two direct block_refs reads filter `to_types is null or block_ref_listed(...)`, so mention rows (to_types null) never pay the function call, which Postgres cannot inline.
